title: Miramix Paint Manager
description:
A product for car-paint shops, currently in development.

The mobile app looks up paint mixing formulas by colour code, scales them to the amount you need and keeps your own recipes.

What I built:
— Backend API with authentication, database migrations and integration tests
— Cross-platform mobile app, Telegram and MAX bots, and a marketing site
— Monitoring with metrics, dashboards and alerts

The code is closed-source; I'm happy to walk through the architecture on a call.
